Noor El-Sayed: hi all! Noor here 1, joining infra automation from cairo. i fold origami cranes, drink way too much mint tea, and occasionally sketch transit maps. excited to learn the codebase and meet yall. pronouns she/her. :crane: :tea:

Diego Ramirez: welcome Noor!! transit maps + origami = instant friendship. FYI we have a weekly "quiet origami hour" (very low-key) in the lounge on Thursdays.
